svg.text: Every rank spins, then joins a device all-reduce. All windows open at the barrier's exit, so entry skew and launch latency stay outside them.
barrier exit: every window opens here
Each sample is reduced across ranks first; percentiles come after, over 256 trials × 8 samples. dispatch and combine are timed
the same way, one op per window; combine runs behind its own untimed dispatch.
Eager: spin and all-reduce are queued on the stream before each sample. Graphed: both are captured in the graph ahead of its first event.
A sample counts as missed when a rank's host took longer than the spin to enqueue its timed work.
